newsitem.title: USA: Dow soars to record close; pulls back from 5,900.
newsitem.headline: Dow soars to record close; pulls back from 5,900.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks soared to a record close Monday building on the previous session's strong gains, though the Dow index failed to hold above the 5,900 level, which it breached for the first time in late trading.

The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 50.68 points at 5,889.20, according to early, unofficial results, after powering to an all-time high of 5,905.47. Advancing issues topped declines 7 to 5 on heavy volume of more than 426 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq index added 5.28 to 1,193.95.
